# spinupwp_server (Data Source)

Looks up a SpinupWP server by `id` or `name`, e.g. to get the `server_id` for a site.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "spinupwp_server" "web" {
  name = "my-server"
}

output "web_ip" {
  value = data.spinupwp_server.web.ip_address
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Server ID.
- `name` (String) Server name. Must be unique in the team.

### Read-Only

- `database_host` (String) Database host.
- `database_server` (String) Database server, e.g. `mysql-8.4` or `external`.
- `ip_address` (String) Public IP address.
- `provider_name` (String) Hosting provider, e.g. `DigitalOcean`.
- `status` (String) Server status, e.g. `provisioned`.
- `ubuntu_version` (String) Ubuntu version, e.g. `26.04`.
